title: The Pitts: Create+ SMP
description: A Modrinth port of the "The Pitts: Create+ SMP" modpack, based on Create and it's addons.
body:
# DISCLAIMER:
**THIS IS A PORT/ADAPTATION OF THE [ORIGINAL MODPACK](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/thepitts-create-smp) FOR MODRINTH. 
THIS PORT IS NOT MADE OR MAINTAINED BY THE ORIGINAL CREATOR OF THE MODPACK AND MAY LOSE SUPPORT AT ANY TIME.**

  The Pitts modpack is created specifically for [The Pitts SMP server](https://discord.gg/HCFzvcJgKW), which is focused on Create and it's addons. Besides Create, this modpack also features QOL mods like Waystones, Sophisticated Backpacks, Sophisticated Storage and other cool mods like [Aquaculture 2](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aquaculture).

 A few examples of Create addons included are:
- Create: The Factory Must Grow
- Create: Dreams n' Desires
- Create: Enchantable Machinery
- Create: Design n' Decor
- Create: Jetpack

 A few examples of QOL mods included are:
-  Waystones
- Comforts
- Immersive Aircraft
- Soph. Storage
- Soph. Backpacks
